title: Why Time Speeds Up As You Get Older
hook: Your perception of time truly accelerates with age.

narration.text: Your perception of time truly accelerates with age.
When you are young, everything feels new, creating many vivid memories.
Each new experience forms a distinct memory, slowing down your internal clock.
As you get older, life often becomes more routine.
Fewer novel memories are created, making days blend together.
This lack of distinct memories makes time seem to fly by faster.
To slow things down, seek out new experiences and learning.
Have you noticed time speeding up in your own life?

description: Ever wonder why each year seems to pass quicker than the last? It is all connected to how our brains form and store memories. We explain the fascinating psychological mechanism behind this common experience.
topic: Why your perception of time speeds up as you get older, linking it to memory formation.
